# Photo collage

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/photo-collage/

Arrange up to nine images into a simple grid with adjustable columns, spacing, background and cell proportions. Create one shareable PNG.

## How to use it

1. Choose your image or enter your own text.
2. Pick a layout, style or output size.
3. Create the result and download your shareable image.

## Example

Make a two-column collage of four project screenshots or travel photos.

## Limits and checks

Images fill their cells with centered crops. Choose a new image set to replace the selection and keep important subjects near each center.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
